content.text:
There it is. The `codecov/project` (default) check shows **83.88% (-5.80%)** compared to base, which exceeds the 2% threshold.

The issue is in the `default` status config. It has `target: auto` with `threshold: 2%`, and the `flags` list only includes `api` and `crypto` — but not `desktop`. Since this PR added desktop Rust test coverage uploads, the overall project coverage calculation is now incorporating the desktop code (which has lower coverage), pulling the aggregate number down.

Here's the situation:

1. **`codecov/project/api`**: 85.77% — passes (target 85%)
2. **`codecov/project/crypto`**: 80.81% — passes (target 80%)  
3. **`codecov/project/desktop`**: passes (no base to compare)
4. **`codecov/project` (default)**: 83.88% — **fails** because it dropped 5.8% from base

The -5.8% drop is because desktop Rust code is now being measured but has low coverage, dragging down the aggregate.

**Two options:**

1. **Adjust the config** (quick fix) — Add `desktop` to the default status flags list, or increase the threshold, or set `target: auto` with a higher threshold like `6%` to account for the desktop addition. Or better: just exclude desktop from the default aggregate since it already has its own status check.

2. **Write more tests** — Would need to add substantial test coverage to the desktop Rust code to bring the aggregate back up ~6 points. That's a lot of test writing for a CI config issue.

I'd recommend option 1 — this is a config artifact, not a real regression. The individual checks all pass. The simplest fix is to either add `desktop` to the default flags (so it's consistently measured) or raise the threshold on the default check to accommodate the new flag.

Want me to adjust the codecov.yml? The cleanest approach would be to add `desktop` to the default flags and bump the threshold to `6%` (or set `informational: true` on the default check so it reports but doesn't block).

# Resolve PR Review Comments

Resolve all open review comments on the current PR from any automated reviewer (CodeRabbit, GitHub Copilot, etc.) or human reviewers.

## Workflow

### 1. Identify the PR


## How Codecov flags work (and how coverage is aggregated)

### 1) What a “flag” is
A **flag** is a label you attach to a coverage upload (typically representing a test type like `unit` vs `integration`, or a subproject like `frontend` vs `backend`). You apply it at upload time (e.g., uploader `-F <flagname>`). ([docs.codecov.com](https://docs.codecov.com/docs/flags?utm_source=openai))

**Important:** Codecov recommends a *one-to-one* relationship between “a report’s contents” and “the flag(s) you apply.” If you upload one combined report and apply multiple flags, each flag can incorrectly show the full report’s coverage. ([docs.codecov.com](https://docs.codecov.com/docs/flags?utm_source=openai))

### 2) How multiple uploads aggregate under a flag
If you upload multiple reports using the **same flag**, Codecov will **merge** them as that flag’s coverage set (useful when a “frontend” flag is produced by multiple jobs). ([docs.codecov.com](https://docs.codecov.com/docs/flags?utm_source=openai))

### 3) How status checks aggregate across flags
In `codecov.yml`, a status check (project or patch) can specify a list of `flags`. The status check’s reported coverage is the **combined coverage from those flags**. ([docs.codecov.com](https://docs.codecov.com/docs/commit-status?utm_source=openai))

Example (single status check computed from `unit` + `integration` uploads):
```yaml
coverage:
  status:
    project:
      app:
        target: auto
        threshold: 1%
        flags:
          - unit
          - integration
```
(Codecov will compute the status using the combined coverage of the listed flags.) ([docs.codecov.com](https://docs.codecov.com/docs/commit-status?utm_source=openai))

## Configuring flags in the project (codecov.yml)

### A) “Bespoke” (manual) flag config: `flags:` + `coverage.status.*.flags`
You can define flags and (optionally) map them to file paths, and then create per-flag status checks by referencing them in `coverage: status:`. ([docs.codecov.com](https://docs.codecov.com/docs/flags?utm_source=openai))

Example pattern:
```yaml
coverage:
  status:
    project:
      frontend:
        flags: [frontend]
      backend:
        flags: [backend]

flags:
  frontend:
    paths:
      - app/frontend/
  backend:
    paths:
      - app/backend/
```
([docs.codecov.com](https://docs.codecov.com/docs/flags?utm_source=openai))

### B) “Automatic flag management”: `flag_management:`
Instead of listing every flag explicitly, you can define **default rules** that apply to any flag you upload, including auto-generated per-flag status checks (via `statuses` rules). ([docs.codecov.com](https://docs.codecov.com/docs/flags?utm_source=openai))

Example (creates per-flag statuses with prefixes and enables carryforward by default):
```yaml
flag_management:
  default_rules:
    carryforward: true
    statuses:
      - name_prefix: project-
        type: project
        target: auto
        threshold: 1%
      - name_prefix: patch-
        type: patch
        target: 90%
```
([about.codecov.io](https://about.codecov.io/blog/introducing-improved-flag-management-with-automatic-flags/?utm_source=openai))

## Carryforward flags (monorepos / partial testing)

### What it does
**Carryforward flags** let Codecov “reuse” the most recent coverage for a flag when that flag wasn’t produced on the current commit—useful when not all subprojects/tests run on every commit. ([docs.codecov.com](https://docs.codecov.com/docs/carryforward-flags?utm_source=openai))

### Visibility note
By default, **carried-forward flags don’t appear in PR comments/statuses** unless you configure your setup accordingly. ([docs.codecov.com](https://docs.codecov.com/docs/carryforward-flags?utm_source=openai))

## Common “why is my status missing?” setting (monorepos)
If a status check uses `flags`, Codecov has a setting to decide what to do when **no new flag coverage** was uploaded on that commit (including cases where coverage is only carried forward): `flag_coverage_not_uploaded_behavior: include|exclude|pass`. ([docs.codecov.com](https://docs.codecov.com/docs/commit-status?utm_source=openai))

name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        )
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t

          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |

              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'

              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        )
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"

          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update

            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \

        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |

          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash

          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Install Rust toolchain

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target

          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          if [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then
            ARCH="darwin-$(uname -m | sed 's/arm64/arm64/' | sed 's/x86_64/amd64/')"
          else
            ARCH="linux-amd64"
          fi
          wget -q "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
          tar -xzf "kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          # Wait for daemon readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $version = "v0.34.0"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/$version/kubo_${version}_windows-amd64.zip" -OutFile kubo.zip
          Expand-Archive -Path kubo.zip -DestinationPath .
          $env:PATH = "$PWD\kubo;$env:PATH"
          [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "$PWD\kubo;$env:PATH", "Process")
          echo "$PWD\kubo" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append
          ipfs init
          Start-Process -FilePath "ipfs" -ArgumentList "daemon" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for daemon readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "IPFS daemon ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time." }

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install redis-64 -y
          Start-Process redis-server -NoNewWindow
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build packages
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:NODE_ENV = "test"
          $env:DB_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:DB_PORT = "5432"
          $env:DB_USERNAME = "postgres"
          $env:DB_PASSWORD = "postgres"
          $env:DB_DATABASE = "cipherbox_test"
          $env:JWT_SECRET = "e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key"
          $env:CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "http://localhost:5173"
          $env:IPFS_PROVIDER = "local"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL = "http://localhost:5001"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL = "http://localhost:8080"
          $env:DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
          $env:REDIS_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:REDIS_PORT = "6379"
          $env:TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY = "${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}"
          Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList "dist/main.js" -WorkingDirectory "apps/api" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for API readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/health" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "API ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "API did not become ready in time." }

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: GabrielBB/xvfb-action@v1
        with:
          run: |
            export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
            export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
            export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
            export RUST_LOG=info
            BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
            chmod +x "$BINARY"
            DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
            "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY &
            DESKTOP_PID=$!
            set +e
            bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
            TEST_EXIT=$?
            set -e
            kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
            fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
            exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:CIPHERBOX_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:RUST_LOG = "info"
          $BINARY = "apps\desktop\src-tauri\target\debug\${{ matrix.binary-name }}"
          $DEV_KEY = -join ((1..32) | ForEach-Object { '{0:x2}' -f (Get-Random -Max 256) })
          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $BINARY -ArgumentList "--dev-key",$DEV_KEY -PassThru -NoNewWindow
          & "$PWD\tests\e2e-desktop\scripts\run-all.ps1"
          $testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          exit $testExit

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-desktop-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
          retention-days: 7

input.command:
git add .github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(ci): gate desktop E2E workflow_run to push events only

Defense-in-depth: restrict workflow_run trigger to only upstream push
events, preventing potential privilege escalation if PR code were to
reach the workflow context. The branches: [main] filter already limits
this, but the explicit event check adds an extra layer of protection.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git push
input.description: Commit and push the security fix

name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        )
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          if [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then
            ARCH="darwin-$(uname -m | sed 's/arm64/arm64/' | sed 's/x86_64/amd64/')"
          else
            ARCH="linux-amd64"
          fi
          wget -q "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
          tar -xzf "kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          # Wait for daemon readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $version = "v0.34.0"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/$version/kubo_${version}_windows-amd64.zip" -OutFile kubo.zip
          Expand-Archive -Path kubo.zip -DestinationPath .
          $env:PATH = "$PWD\kubo;$env:PATH"
          [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "$PWD\kubo;$env:PATH", "Process")
          echo "$PWD\kubo" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append
          ipfs init
          Start-Process -FilePath "ipfs" -ArgumentList "daemon" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for daemon readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "IPFS daemon ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time." }

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install redis-64 -y
          Start-Process redis-server -NoNewWindow
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build packages
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:NODE_ENV = "test"
          $env:DB_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:DB_PORT = "5432"
          $env:DB_USERNAME = "postgres"
          $env:DB_PASSWORD = "postgres"
          $env:DB_DATABASE = "cipherbox_test"
          $env:JWT_SECRET = "e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key"
          $env:CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "http://localhost:5173"
          $env:IPFS_PROVIDER = "local"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL = "http://localhost:5001"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL = "http://localhost:8080"
          $env:DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
          $env:REDIS_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:REDIS_PORT = "6379"
          $env:TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY = "${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}"
          Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList "dist/main.js" -WorkingDirectory "apps/api" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for API readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/health" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "API ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "API did not become ready in time." }

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: GabrielBB/xvfb-action@v1
        with:
          run: |
            export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
            export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
            export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
            export RUST_LOG=info
            BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
            chmod +x "$BINARY"
            DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
            "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY &
            DESKTOP_PID=$!
            set +e
            bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
            TEST_EXIT=$?
            set -e
            kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
            fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
            exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:CIPHERBOX_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:RUST_LOG = "info"
          $BINARY = "apps\desktop\src-tauri\target\debug\${{ matrix.binary-name }}"
          $DEV_KEY = -join ((1..32) | ForEach-Object { '{0:x2}' -f (Get-Random -Max 256) })
          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $BINARY -ArgumentList "--dev-key",$DEV_KEY -PassThru -NoNewWindow
          & "$PWD\tests\e2e-desktop\scripts\run-all.ps1"
          $testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          exit $testExit

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-desktop-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
          retention-days: 7

              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'

    needs: [changes]

        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&

            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:

            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"

          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"

        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          if [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then
            ARCH="darwin-$(uname -m | sed 's/arm64/arm64/' | sed 's/x86_64/amd64/')"
          else
            ARCH="linux-amd64"
          fi
          wget -q "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
          tar -xzf "kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          # Wait for daemon readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

        run: |
          $version = "v0.34.0"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/$version/kubo_${version}_windows-amd64.zip" -OutFile kubo.zip

          $env:PATH = "$PWD\kubo;$env:PATH"
          [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "$PWD\kubo;$env:PATH", "Process")
          echo "$PWD\kubo" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append
          ipfs init
          Start-Process -FilePath "ipfs" -ArgumentList "daemon" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for daemon readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "IPFS daemon ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time." }

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install redis-64 -y
          Start-Process redis-server -NoNewWindow
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build packages
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api build

        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

        env:

          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:NODE_ENV = "test"
          $env:DB_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:DB_PORT = "5432"
          $env:DB_USERNAME = "postgres"
          $env:DB_PASSWORD = "postgres"
          $env:DB_DATABASE = "cipherbox_test"
          $env:JWT_SECRET = "e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key"
          $env:CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "http://localhost:5173"
          $env:IPFS_PROVIDER = "local"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL = "http://localhost:5001"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL = "http://localhost:8080"
          $env:DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
          $env:REDIS_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:REDIS_PORT = "6379"
          $env:TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY = "${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}"
          Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList "dist/main.js" -WorkingDirectory "apps/api" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for API readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/health" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "API ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "API did not become ready in time." }

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: GabrielBB/xvfb-action@v1
        with:
          run: |
            export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
            export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
            export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
            export RUST_LOG=info
            BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
            chmod +x "$BINARY"
            DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
            "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY &
            DESKTOP_PID=$!
            set +e
            bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
            TEST_EXIT=$?
            set -e
            kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
            fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
            exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:CIPHERBOX_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:RUST_LOG = "info"
          $BINARY = "apps\desktop\src-tauri\target\debug\${{ matrix.binary-name }}"
          $DEV_KEY = -join ((1..32) | ForEach-Object { '{0:x2}' -f (Get-Random -Max 256) })
          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $BINARY -ArgumentList "--dev-key",$DEV_KEY -PassThru -NoNewWindow
          & "$PWD\tests\e2e-desktop\scripts\run-all.ps1"
          $testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          exit $testExit

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-desktop-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
          retention-days: 7

name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'

    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})

          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: GabrielBB/xvfb-action@v1
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: info
        with:
          run: >-
            bash -c '
            BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }};
            chmod +x "$BINARY";
            DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32);
            "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY &
            DESKTOP_PID=$!;
            set +e;
            bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh;
            TEST_EXIT=$?;
            set -e;
            kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true;
            fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true;
            exit $TEST_EXIT'

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:CIPHERBOX_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:RUST_LOG = "info"
          $BINARY = "apps\desktop\src-tauri\target\debug\${{ matrix.binary-name }}"
          $DEV_KEY = -join ((1..32) | ForEach-Object { '{0:x2}' -f (Get-Random -Max 256) })
          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $BINARY -ArgumentList "--dev-key",$DEV_KEY -PassThru -NoNewWindow
          & "$PWD\tests\e2e-desktop\scripts\run-all.ps1"
          $testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          exit $testExit

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-desktop-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
          retention-days: 7

            ARCH="linux-amd64"

git add .github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(ci): fix desktop E2E failures on macOS and Linux

macOS: Replace wget with curl for Kubo download — wget is not
available on macOS GitHub runners, causing silent download failure
and subsequent "command not found" for install.sh.

Linux: Fix xvfb-action multi-line run — GabrielBB/xvfb-action@v1
executes each line as a separate xvfb-run invocation, so export
and variable assignments fail as standalone commands. Move env vars
to step-level env: and wrap commands in a single bash -c invocation.

Also adds workflow_run.event == 'push' guard (defense-in-depth from
PR #227 that was lost in squash merge).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git push -u origin fix/desktop-e2e-ci-issues

## Summary
- **macOS**: Replace `wget` with `curl` for Kubo (IPFS) download — `wget` is not available on macOS GitHub runners, causing silent download failure and `command not found` for `install.sh`
- **Linux**: Fix `GabrielBB/xvfb-action@v1` multi-line `run` — the action executes each line as a separate `xvfb-run` invocation, so `export` and variable assignments fail as standalone commands. Moved env vars to step-level `env:` and wrapped commands in a single `bash -c` invocation
- Re-adds `workflow_run.event == 'push'` guard (defense-in-depth from PR #227 lost in squash merge)

## Test plan
- [ ] macOS desktop E2E job passes (Kubo installs successfully)
- [ ] Linux desktop E2E job passes (xvfb-action runs script correctly)
- [ ] Windows desktop E2E job unaffected

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
)"

PR created: https://github.com/FSM1/cipher-box/pull/228

**Fixes:**
- **macOS**: `wget` → `curl -fsSL -o` for Kubo download (wget not on macOS runners)
- **Linux**: Moved env vars to step-level `env:` and wrapped the xvfb-action `run:` in a single `bash -c` invocation (the action runs each line as a separate `xvfb-run` command)
- Re-added the `workflow_run.event == 'push'` guard that was lost in the squash merge

The Windows issue is interesting. The IPFS daemon log shows "Daemon is ready" at `03:26:55`, but the readiness check loop still fails with "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time" at `03:27:27` (~32 seconds later, so it ran through all 30 iterations).

The problem is that `Start-Process -NoNewWindow` starts IPFS in a separate process, but the output from the daemon bleeds into the PowerShell output. The readiness check loop uses `Invoke-WebRequest` which should work...

Wait, looking more closely at the timestamps:


- `03:26:54` - IPFS init and daemon starting
- `03:26:55` - "Daemon is ready" 
- `03:27:27` - "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time"

The daemon claims it's ready at 03:26:55, but then all 30 iterations of the readiness check fail over the next 30 seconds. That means the `Invoke-WebRequest` calls are consistently failing even though the daemon says it's ready. The issue might be that on Windows, starting the daemon with `Start-Process -NoNewWindow` causes output buffering or timing issues that prevent the readiness check from actually connecting.

I'm thinking the real problem is that `Invoke-WebRequest` is sending a GET request to `/api/v0/id`, but IPFS v0.34.0 might require POST for that endpoint, or there could be a Windows firewall issue blocking localhost connections, or PowerShell's HTTP client might have SSL/TLS quirks that `curl` doesn't have on Unix.

Looking at the Kubo changelog, starting from v0.29.0 the RPC API requires POST for all endpoints by default, so even the Unix `curl` command might fail if it's using GET. But I can't actually confirm whether the Unix version works since the macOS job failed during Kubo installation and the Linux job failed at xvfb, so neither of them actually reached the daemon check.

The fix for Windows is to explicitly specify POST when making the request to the IPFS API endpoint.

For Unix, the current `curl` command does a GET request, which would also fail with a 405 error if Kubo v0.34.0 requires POST. However, since the script redirects stderr and only checks the exit code, a 405 HTTP response would still return exit code 0, so the check might pass even though the request technically failed.

The Windows side behaves differently — `Invoke-WebRequest` with `-ErrorAction Stop` throws an exception on any non-2xx response, so a 405 would trigger the catch block and fail the check. That's the actual problem here.

I need to add `-Method Post` to the Windows PowerShell command and also update the Unix side to use `-X POST` for consistency, even though it might work by accident currently.

name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        )
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          if [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then
            ARCH="darwin-$(uname -m | sed 's/arm64/arm64/' | sed 's/x86_64/amd64/')"
          else
            ARCH="linux-amd64"
          fi
          curl -fsSL -o "kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_${ARCH}.tar.gz" "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
          tar -xzf "kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          # Wait for daemon readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $version = "v0.34.0"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/$version/kubo_${version}_windows-amd64.zip" -OutFile kubo.zip
          Expand-Archive -Path kubo.zip -DestinationPath .
          $env:PATH = "$PWD\kubo;$env:PATH"
          [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "$PWD\kubo;$env:PATH", "Process")
          echo "$PWD\kubo" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append
          ipfs init
          Start-Process -FilePath "ipfs" -ArgumentList "daemon" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for daemon readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "IPFS daemon ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time." }

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install redis-64 -y
          Start-Process redis-server -NoNewWindow
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build packages
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:NODE_ENV = "test"
          $env:DB_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:DB_PORT = "5432"
          $env:DB_USERNAME = "postgres"
          $env:DB_PASSWORD = "postgres"
          $env:DB_DATABASE = "cipherbox_test"
          $env:JWT_SECRET = "e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key"
          $env:CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "http://localhost:5173"
          $env:IPFS_PROVIDER = "local"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL = "http://localhost:5001"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL = "http://localhost:8080"
          $env:DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
          $env:REDIS_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:REDIS_PORT = "6379"
          $env:TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY = "${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}"
          Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList "dist/main.js" -WorkingDirectory "apps/api" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for API readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/health" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "API ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "API did not become ready in time." }

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: GabrielBB/xvfb-action@v1
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: info
        with:
          run: >-
            bash -c '
            BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }};
            chmod +x "$BINARY";
            DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32);
            "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY &
            DESKTOP_PID=$!;
            set +e;
            bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh;
            TEST_EXIT=$?;
            set -e;
            kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true;
            fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true;
            exit $TEST_EXIT'

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:CIPHERBOX_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:RUST_LOG = "info"
          $BINARY = "apps\desktop\src-tauri\target\debug\${{ matrix.binary-name }}"
          $DEV_KEY = -join ((1..32) | ForEach-Object { '{0:x2}' -f (Get-Random -Max 256) })
          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $BINARY -ArgumentList "--dev-key",$DEV_KEY -PassThru -NoNewWindow
          & "$PWD\tests\e2e-desktop\scripts\run-all.ps1"
          $testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          exit $testExit

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-desktop-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
          retention-days: 7
